findings.description: The app assumes the "Employee Data" sheet exists and has standard column headers. If the sheet is missing or renamed, getEmployeeData() will throw an error that surfaces to the user, but pre-flight validation at app load would be better. Consider checking sheet existence on page load.

The system allows the same employee to check in multiple times with no deduplication or time-window validation. For an event check-in flow, multiple entries for one person within seconds is likely accidental. Consider adding a configurable dedup window (e.g., "skip if checked in within the last 2 minutes").

findings.issue: QR input not validated as QR
findings.description: The qrInput field accepts any text; there is no validation that the scanned value is actually a QR code. A barcode scanner would paste the raw employee ID, which works, but a typo in manual entry is not caught. Consider adding optional format hints or warnings in the UI.
